title: Mandatory Gear — Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: For PAGODA 50 DAY the mandatory list contains 13 items: running pack, mobile phone, personal collapsible cup of at least 150 ml, at least 1 litre of water, one working headlamp with spare batteries, survival blanket of at least 1.40 m x 2 m, food, windproof jacket with hood and DWR protection, LED/flashing light or reflective vest/belt, first-aid kit, whistle, cap/bandana/buff, and reusable bowl with spoon or spork, plus a passport or ID card.
The PAGODA 50 DAY mandatory shell is a windproof jacket with hood and DWR protection; a waterproof rain jacket is not on the mandatory list for this race.
The mandatory water minimum for PAGODA 50 DAY is 1 litre, to be carried in hydration packs or bottles, and water in plastic bags or ziplock bags is not permitted.
The recommended gear for PAGODA 50 DAY includes warm gloves, spare warm clothing, long trousers or socks covering the legs, sunglasses, arm sleeves, and Vaseline or anti-heat cream.
The page states that the organiser may add items to the mandatory list according to the weather forecast, with the final list confirmed one or two days before the race.
The page states that the mandatory first-aid kit should include wound care and pain relievers, and that NSAIDs are prohibited.
The PAGODA 50 NIGHT mandatory list is the same 13-item list as the DAY race.
